\id TIT
\usfm 3.0
\mt TITA
\mt2 Hnenih Paul Cakuat
\ip Cangantu: Paul
\ip Casiartu: Tita
\ip Ngan kum: A.D. 65
\ip Zentelmi Tita hi Paul-ih rawngbawlnak ruangih zumtu ih cang mi a si men thei (1:4). Anih cu Antiok le Jerusalem ah Paul thawn an thlunaw dah (Gal 2:1-3). Anih hi Paul in Galatia ramṭhen pál in a vei khatnak missionary khual a tlawn laiah a tel ding ti zum a si. Paul ih missionary khualtlawn a vei thumnak khalah a tel ih, Korinth khua ih thubuai tifel dingah Paul ih a hril mi a si ( 2Korinth Thuhmaihruai siar aw). Tita-ih hmin hi 2Korinth sungah vei tampi a lang (2:13; 7:6, 13-15; 8:6, 16, 23; 12:18). Cumi in amah hi nun dik nei mi le rawngbawlnak ah rintlak a si ti a langter. Cuvek minung a si ruangah Khirit kawhhran pitlingter dingah Paul in a hril hi mangbang ding a um lo (Tit 1:5).
\ip Mediterranean Tifinriat ih Khirit tikulh kaupi hi Rom in a rak uk mi a si. Hi tikulh ih mipawl hi nuncan lam le tlanlendān lamah an hmin a rak sia (1:12), asinan thuthangṭha cun an nun a thleng. Khirit mipawl in Pentikos ni ah Peter ih thusim mi an ngainak ihsin an hnenah thuthangṭha a rak thleng thăwk a si men thei (Apo 2:11). Hi tikulh hi Paul in thawngtla dinhmun in Rom khawpi a pan tikah a pál phah (Apo 27:7-13). Rom ralkappawl in Paul an thlah hnuah (1Timothy Thuhmaihruai siar aw), Tita thawn Khirit ah a tlawngsal. Cumi ṭum ah rei deuh a cam a bang. Khirit a suahsăn tikah cutawk ih rawngbawlnak hlĕnsuak dingin Tita a ruat (1:5). Paul in Efesa le Masidonia a tlawn hnuah Tita hnenah, a hrangih lamhmuhtu ah, cakuat a ngan. Cuih kum cu A.D. 65 hrawng a si.
\ip Tita cakuat hin thurin dik thawn milawin hna ṭha kan ṭuan ih, nundān dikin kan nun le kan tlanlēn theinak dingah, Khrih in in rundam thu in zirh. Sikhalsehla cumi dawnkhamtu thil pathum Paul in a buaipi, cupawl cu zirhnak diklo, Pathian ngaihsaklonak le leitlun câkhiarnak tla an si. Dawnkhamtu a pakhatnak cu bung khatnak ah a buaipi ih, a tling mi elder-pawl nĕmhngeh a pawimawhzia a sim. Bung 2-3 ah dawnkhamtu dang pahnih thu a buaipi ih, kawhhran sungih zumtupawl cu an kum izirih kăwmdan ding le pehtlaihdān ding pawl a rel.
\ip Pathian zangfahnak in rundamnak ah in hruai ih, sual nehdān le hnaṭuan ṭha hrangih ṭhahnemngaidān ding thupawl in zirh (2:11-14).
\c 1
\s Cibaibûknak
\p
\v 1 Pathian hril mipawlih zumnak le Pathian ngaihsak zawngih thutak theihnak famkim zulhih Pathian ṭēmṭawn sál le Jesu Khrih-ih apostol Paul in,
\v 2 thuphan per thei lo Pathian in leilung sēm hlanin sankhuk nunnak ruahsannak a rak tiam.
\v 3 Asinan in rundamtu Pathian thupek bangtukin ka hnenih kăwlter mi cu, thusimnak thawngin a kamsuakthu cu a tikcu teah a langter.
\p
\v 4 Zumnak hmunkhatih ka fapa taktak Tita hnenah:
\p Pa Pathian le in Rundamtu Bawi Jesu Khrih hnen ihsin zangfahnak, zahngainak le hnangamdaihnak um hram seh.
\s Elder Tlinnak
\p
\v 5 Khirit tikulh ih ka lo tantanak săn cu thu ka lo pek vekin, thil tifel thluh lo mipawl tifel dingin le khaw tin ah elder-pawl ruat dingin a si.
\v 6 Bishop si dingah mi pakhat cu sawihnăwm ding um lo, nupi pakhat nei, a fatepawl zumtu si mi, pawisaklonak nun ah simaw, luhlulnak thu ah simaw sawihnăwm ding um lo a si ding a si.
\v 7 Ziangahtile Bishop cu Pathian sumkiltu a si vekin, sawihnăwm ding um lo a si tengteng ding a si. Mai thu duh, thinheng áwl, sabitzu phâm, mihrohrang, paisa duham mi a si lo ding a si.
\v 8 Cuhnakin mikhual duhtu, thil ṭha duhtu, supaw thei, midingfel, mithianghlim, mah le mah thununaw thei mi a si sawn ding a si.
\v 9 Zirh a rak si zo bangin rintlak kamsuakthu kaihngettu a si ding a si, cutin zirhnak ziktluak hmangin tha mi a pe thei ding ih, dokalhtupawl a êl thei hai ding.
\s Elder Ṭuanvo
\p
\v 10 Ziangahtile thunun harsapawl, thulolakmen ṭawngtupawl le mibumhmangpawl tampi an um, a hleicein cupawl cu serhzimtanpawl lak ihsin an si.
\v 11 Cupawlih ka cu huhsak tengteng ding a si, diklo zetih hlawk duh ruangah zirh lo ding mi thilpawl an zirh ih, sungkurûn in mi an siatsuah.
\v 12 Anmai lakih mi pakhat, anmai profet rori hmanin, <<Khrit tikulhmipawl cu thuphanper, sahrang sual, mizê rawl phâm an si,>> tiah a ti.
\v 13 Hi theihternak cu a dik a si. Curuangah zumnak lamah an ziktluak theinak dingah, Khrit tikulh mipawl cu na zetin kawk hai aw.
\v 14 Jew-pawlih phuahcăwp thuanthupawl le thutak dungtuntu minungpawlih thupekpawl cu ngaihsak hlah.
\v 15 Mithiangpawl hrangah cun thil ziangkim hi an thiang. Asinan mibawrhbang le zumlotu pawl hrangah cun a thiang mi zianghman a um lo. An lungthin le an sia le ṭha theihnak khal a bawrhhlawh ṭheh.
\v 16 Pathian kan thei tiah an phuang nân, an hnaṭuannak in amah an phatsăn. Annih cu Pathian huat mi tuahtu, thulung lo le hna ṭha ṭuannak tinkim ih santlailo an si.
\c 2
\s Kawhhran dik Tlinnak
\p
\v 1 Sikhalsehla nang cun zirhnak ziktluak thawi milaw mi thupawl sim aw:
\v 2 cutin putarpawl cu supaw in, mizahum, thununaw thei mi, zumnak le duhdawtnak le tuarfainak ah ziktluak dingin zirh hai aw.
\v 3 Cutivek thothoin, pitarpawl khal mirelsiathmang lo, sabitzu phâm lo, thil ṭha zirhtu si sawnin, an nundān cu zahum zetih um dingin tha pe aw.
\v 4 Cutin annih in nupinu no lai deuhpawl cu supaw thei dingin, an pasal duhdaw dingin, an fate duhdaw dingin,
\v 5 thinlung fel zet pu dingin, thianghlim dingin, innsang kilkhawitu si dingin, ṭha zetih um dingin, an pasal thu ngai dingin nun an zirh thei ding. Cutin Pathian kamsuakthu cu thangsiatin a um lo ding.
\p
\v 6 Cutivek thothoin, tlangvalpawl cu supaw dingin fawrh hai aw.
\v 7 Thil ziangkimah thil ṭha tuahnak in zohṭhim ding mi ah tuahaw aw; zirhnak ah na takzia, na zahumzia, na dikzia,
\v 8 thiamlo coter theih lo na thusim ziktluak pawl langter aw. Cuticun a lo dodaltu in na thuhla ah thil ṭhalo zianghman sim ding a neih lo ruangah a ning a zak ding.
\p
\v 9 Sálpawl cu an bawipawlih ṭawng sawnkir loin, an thulung sawn dingin le thil ziangkimah an lungawiter dingin fawrh hai aw.
\v 10 In Rundamtu Pathian thuhla zirhnak cu thil ziangkimah duhum zetih an lăngter theinak dingah, an bawipawlih thil rûksak loin rinumnak ṭha hmuahhmuah langter sawn dingin fawrh hai aw.
\p
\v 11 Ziangahtile rundamnak thlentu Pathian zangfahnak cu mi hmuahhmuah hnenah a rung lang zo.
\v 12 Cuih Pathian zangfahnak cun Pathian ngaihsaklonak le khawvel câkhiarnak pawl tlansăn in tulai san ah supaw le dingfel zet le Pathian ngaihsak ih nung ding kan si ti in zirh.
\v 13 Ruahsannak lungawium kan hngah laiah hin cutivekih nung ding kan si, cuih ruahsannak cu Pathian ropi, in Rundamtu Jesu Khrih-ih rung lăngnak sunglawi zet cu a si.
\v 14 Anih cun dān lo i nunnak hmuahhmuah sung ihsin in tlen theinak dingah le amah hnenih thenfai mi, amai mihleice, hnaṭuan ṭha hrangih ṭhahnemngai mi kan si theinak dingah kan hrangah amah le amah a peaw.
\p
\v 15 Hi thilpawl cu thuneihnak hmuahhmuah thawn sim aw, fawrh awla, kawk aw. Zohman in lo nautat hlah hai seh.
\c 3
\s Thil Ṭha Ti
\p
\v 1 Uktupawl le thuneitupawl hnenah tlulut dingin, an thu ngai dingin, thil ṭha tinkim tuah dingih tiar cia dingin zumtupawl cu theihtersal hai aw.
\v 2 Zo hnen hmanah ṭawng sia ṭawng lo le mielbuaihmang si loin, zaidam le mi hmuahhmuah hnenah nunnemnak langter sawn dingin anmah cu theihtersal hai aw.
\v 3 Ziangahtile kanmah rori khal hi hlanah âtnak ah, thulunlonak ah, bumnak ah, câkhiarnak a phunphun le năwmnak a phunphun rian in, mi dang parah lungput siava le iksiknak, huatthlala le pakhat le pakhat huaawtăwn in kan rak um dah.
\v 4 Asinan Rundamtu Pathian-ih ngilneihnak le duhdawtnak cu minung hnenah a rung lang zo.
\v 5 Dingfelnak hnaṭuan kan rak ṭuan mi ruangah si loin, a zahngainak zulh sawnin hrinsalnak hmangih khawlhfainak le Thlarau Thianghlim hmangih titharsalnak cun in rundam a si.
\v 6 Cuih Thlarau Thianghlim cu in Rundamtu Jesu Khrih hmangin nasazetin kan parah Pathian in a run burh.
\v 7 Cuticun kan ruahsan mi sankhuk nunnak zulhin ro cotu ih tuah kan si theinak dingah, a zangfahnak in thiamcoter kan si.
\p
\v 8 Pathian rak zum zotupawl cu hnaṭuan ṭha ṭuan vivo dingin ralring hai seh, ti thu hi milai hrangah a ṭha ih a hlawk a si. Hi ṭawngkam hi rinsantlak a si. Hi thilpawl hi nasazetin phuang awla ka duh.
\p
\v 9 Sikhalsehla atthlak thusuhnakpawl, cithlahsawnawknak zâwtsalnak, tawhawknakpawl le Dān thu ih elawknakpawl cu hrial aw; ziangahtile cupawl cu hlawknak um lo le ṭhathnemnak nei lo an si.
\v 10 Ṭhenṭhekawknak tuah ṭheutu cu vei khat nunsim aw, a vei hnihnak nunsim leh awla, cuih hnu cun hnawng aw.
\v 11 Cutivek minung cu amah le amah thiamlo cohawin a rak fehpêng ih, thilsual a tuah a si ti nan thei.
\s Thucah le Cibaibûknak
\p
\v 12 Arṭemas asilole Ṭaikikas kha na hnenih ka rak thlah tikah, Nikopolis khua ah ka hnenah rat hramhram tum aw, ziangahtile thlatang sung cutawk ih um ka tum.
\v 13 Dānthiam Zenas le Apollos in an khualtlawn vivo nak ah zianghman an tlaksămlonak dingah, ṭhahnemngai zetin rak bawm hai aw.
\v 14 Cule kanmai mipawl khalin rah nei loih an umlonak dingah, ṭulpawinak ih hman dingah hnaṭuan ṭha ṭuan vivo zir hai seh.
\p
\v 15 Ka hnenih um hmuahhmuah in cibai an lo bûk. Zumnak ih in duhdawtupawl kha cibai in rak bûksak aw.
\p Nan zate hnenah zangfahnak um hram seh. Amen.

contextId.occurrenceNote: Here, **godliness** is an abstract noun that refers to living in a way that pleases God. Alternate translation: [that is suitable for honoring God]
If your language does not use an abstract noun for the idea of **hope**, you could express the same idea in another way. Alternate translation: [which leads us to confidently expect eternal life]
Paul speaks of God’s word as if it were an object that could be visibly shown to people. Alternate translation: [he caused me to understand his message]

selections.text: kamsuakthu cu a tikcu teah a langter.

contextId.occurrenceNote: Though Titus was not Paul’s biological **son**, they share a common faith in Christ. Paul considers relationship to Christ through faith to be more important than biological relationship. Thus, because of their relative ages and shared faith in Christ, Paul considers Titus as his own son. It may also be that Paul led Titus to faith in Christ, and so Titus is like a son in this spiritual sense. Alternate translation: [like a son to me]
